answer: Delivery-commitment bond: each identity stakes 70 to register a parcel at the anchor depot with a sonnet receipt. A courier carries it to the summit checkpoint for weighing and stamping. Auditors replay the anchor board: reused sonnet, wrong weight, or missing summit stamp burns it. The k-th fake pays 34+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,101,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-haul rings fail on one key stamping too many parcels. Honest agents pay 34 once.
